question: Which of the following female runners won the women’s race in the Paris Marathon 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bedatu Hirpa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bedatu Hirpa**, a professional long-distance runner from Ethiopia, won the **women’s race at the Paris Marathon 2025**.
 
• The Paris Marathon is one of the most prestigious marathons globally, attracting elite athletes from around the world. In **2025**, it was held on its traditional route, starting at the Arc de Triomphe and finishing near the Eiffel Tower.
 
• Hirpa's victory was notable for her strategic pacing, as she maintained a consistent speed throughout the race and pulled away from competitors in the final kilometers.
 
• This triumph adds to Ethiopia’s strong legacy in long-distance running, as the country has produced numerous world-class marathon runners.
 
• Hirpa’s winning time was impressive, showcasing her endurance and skill in tackling the challenging course of the Paris Marathon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Paris Marathon:**

 
 
• The Paris Marathon, officially known as the **Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris**, is an annual event held in Paris, France.
 
• It is one of the biggest marathons globally, attracting over **55,000 participants** annually, including elite athletes and amateur runners.
 
• The race covers a distance of **42.195 kilometers** and features iconic landmarks such as the Champs-Élysées, Place de la Concorde, and the Seine River.
 
 
 
• **Bedatu Hirpa:**
 
 
• Bedatu Hirpa is a renowned **Ethiopian long-distance runner** specializing in marathon and half-marathon events.
 
• She has consistently performed well in international marathons, often finishing in top positions.
 
• Her training focuses on high-altitude preparation, common among Ethiopian runners, which enhances endurance and stamina.
 
 
 
• **Other Competitors:**
 
 
• **Angela Tanui:** An accomplished Kenyan marathon runner, known for her victories in various international marathons, but she did not win the Paris Marathon 2025.
 
• **Dera Dida:** Another elite Ethiopian runner, famous for her performances in cross-country and road running events, though she did not claim the Paris Marathon title in 2025.
 
• **Letesenbet Gidey:** A world record holder in track events, she focuses more on shorter distances and track races rather than full marathons.
 
 
 
• **Ethiopia’s Dominance in Long-Distance Running:**
 
 
• Ethiopia has a long history of excellence in long-distance running, producing legends like **Haile Gebrselassie** and **Derartu Tulu**.
 
• The country’s high-altitude environment is ideal for training, giving runners a physiological advantage during competitions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Paris Marathon 2025 Highlights:**

 
 
• The event took place on a cool spring morning, which provided ideal conditions for long-distance running.
 
• Bedatu Hirpa’s victory highlighted her tactical race execution and strong finish.
 
• The marathon also saw record participation, with runners from over **150 countries**.
 
 
 
• **Training Techniques of Ethiopian Runners:**
 
 
• Ethiopian runners often train at altitudes above **2,500 meters**, which improves oxygen efficiency.
 
• Their training emphasizes **interval runs, endurance building, and diet rich in carbohydrates**.
 
• The strong community support and competitive culture in Ethiopia play a crucial role in nurturing talent.
